notes:
The second reading preserves all text, displayed indices, readable cancellations and source marks except for the absent opening parenthesis before the raised phi condition and the certainty-only resolution of the final close to ]. Thus the page retains both phi in S) and (cas explicité] as unmatched written delimiters. Five insertion leaders are now reproduced as single pen sweeps, including their downward insertion curls and rising right ends; crossings with letters do not make those words deleted. The infinity replacement remains above the start of the struck infini, while its accompanying clause lies farther right.

The first replacement connector in (18) is copied as a shallow shaft and short cap under the cancelled cluster. Its possible right-arrow intention is left open; the other two arrowheads are retained. Formula (19) has two open left corners. The large drawing retains all labels, ten opposed corner arcs, hatching, dark routes and the isolated upper-left-headed turn. Three local joins are made literal: the upper pale-ring gap, the left horizontal ending short of the upright, and the three separated tips beside the lower inner 1. The small dark round dab at approximately (452,1637) has no label or route attachment; it is noted as an incidental unassigned speck and is not promoted to a mathematical vertex.

The low separate oblique after the caption dash is copied under uncertainty, without declaring it a comma. H's generic drawing prose supplies no local geometry for the new ring/junction corrections. The H omission flags for D30, D31, D32 and D33 are therefore withdrawn as documentary scope corrections: H provides no positive local reading for the tiny oval, overwritten glyph, central path label or isolated turn. Their original C comparisons and the final drawing remain unchanged. The old cancelled words and crowded source/target clusters remain doubtful where the single reused crops did not separate their strokes. No mathematical correction or proof is claimed: this audit performed visual collation, not an independent derivation of the presentation or freeness assertion.

Concrete open questions were checked in nine existing crops and three newly created crops of genuinely uncovered places. All drawing labels, route endpoints, ten opposed corner arcs, two pale circular contours, hatches, the small turn and overwritten mark were inspected in the native half and existing full drawing crop.
